# Input

> Source: https://docs.zaloplatforms.com/docs/MA/zaui/form/Input

Last updated: 28/10/2026

```ts
import { Input } from "zmp-ui";
```

Used to create an input field that allows the user to enter text and capture data

## Usage


### Props

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | InputHTMLAttributes['value'] | No | The value of the input.<br>Must be used together with `onChange` to update the value. |
| onChange | InputHTMLAttributes['onChange'] | No | Callback called when the value of the input changes. The value of `value` must be updated if it is passed in. |
| type | InputType | No | The input type. |
| status | InputStatus | No | The validity state of the input. If it is `error`, the input will have a warning color along with `errorText`; otherwise, the input will have a neutral color along with `helperText`. |
| onPressEnter | KeyboardEventHandler | No | Callback called when the user presses Enter or inserts a new line in the input. |
| size | InputSize | No | The size of the input. Takes one of the values `small`, `medium`, or `large`. (default: `'medium'`) |

## Design guidelines

##### Input Field

Used to enter and submit data, so it must be concise and clear

---


###### Core elements (Required)

Always present in an input field

![Base Input](data:image/png;base64,)

- Background
- Border
- Primary text

---

###### Types

Use different types of input fields to meet different content entry needs

---

###### Text Field

For entering simple content in a single line

![Text Input](data:image/png;base64,)

---

###### Password Field

For entering a password

![Password Input](data:image/png;base64,)

---

###### Text Area

For entering long content

![Textarea](data:image/png;base64,)

---

###### Search Field

For entering search content in a single line

![Search Input](data:image/png;base64,)

**Interaction**

- Tap on the trigger to enter text

---

###### OTP Field

Used to enter an OTP. Highlights each digit as you type

![OTP](data:image/png;base64,)
